# Orchestrator — Sharpnr

> Orchestrator is a Sharpnr product for orchestrating Sharpnr services and apps — manage your organization, properties, payments, and integrations from one console.

Orchestrator is the central control plane of the Sharpnr suite. It is an authenticated single-page application: the areas listed below require an account and are not publicly accessible, so they are intentionally excluded from crawling and indexing.

## Product

- [Orchestrator landing](https://orchestrator.sharpnr.com/): Public overview of the Orchestrator console.

## Sharpnr suite

- [Auth](https://auth.sharpnr.com): Identity and access management.
- [Accounting](https://accounting.sharpnr.com): Accounting app.
- [Hospitality](https://hospitality.sharpnr.com): Hospitality operations.
- [SharpCRM](https://sharpcrm.sharpnr.com): Customer relationship management.
- [HR](https://hr.sharpnr.com): Human resources.
- [Marketplace](https://marketplace.sharpnr.com): Apps and integrations marketplace.

## Notes

- Authenticated app areas (organization, properties, payments, authorization, audit log, integrations) live behind login and are not indexed.
